nodes.label: Frontend HTML Entrypoint & Color-Scheme Bootstrapper (frontend/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Synchronously restores persisted light/dark color-scheme from localStorage before first paint to prevent theme flash and mounts /src/main.tsx.

nodes.label: React 19 + Tailwind v4 Frontend Architecture
nodes.rationale: Modular React 19 UI with zero inline style attributes, bidirectional EUR/USD converter (1 USD = 0.92 EUR), DDE-safe CSV export, native <dialog> LogInspectorDrawer, and light/dark theme toggle.

nodes.label: RouterService (Heuristics, DLP, Semantic Cache, FinOps & Wallet)
nodes.norm_label: routerservice (heuristics, dlp, semantic cache, finops & wallet)
nodes.rationale: Core backend service executing input validation, DLP PII/secret redaction, token estimation (words * 1.3), complexity routing (<=50 tokens -> gemini-2.5-flash, >50 or keywords -> gemini-2.5-pro), FinOps 80% downgrade / 100% HTTP 402 block, Zero-Cost Semantic Cache, and BigDecimal cost calculation.

nodes.label: RateLimitingFilter, SecurityConfig & Multi-Tenant Hardening
nodes.rationale: Enforces 20 req/min per X-API-Key/IP with IP rotation guard and bucket pruning, SHA-256 API key hashing, strict ApiKey.userId == PromptRequest.userId ownership, BYOK cache isolation, and synchronized per-user wallet locks.

nodes.label: Flyway SQL Migrations (V1 to V6)
nodes.rationale: Versioned SQL schema governing request_logs (V1, V3, V6), user_budgets (V2), api_keys (V4), and user_wallets (V5).

nodes.label: 3-Tier Hybrid Gemini Execution (BYOK / Server Key / Resilient Simulation)
nodes.norm_label: 3-tier hybrid gemini execution (byok / server key / resilient simulation)
nodes.rationale: Allows zero-cost testing in simulation mode while supporting live Google Gemini API calls via user X-API-Key header (Tier 1) or server GEMINI_API_KEY (Tier 2) with transparent fallback.

nodes.label: Tech Lead & Orquestador (00-orquestador)
nodes.rationale: Coordinates domain-specialized subagents in strict dependency order (Data -> Backend -> Security -> Frontend -> QA) to prevent merge collisions and enforce Spanish Javadoc.

nodes.label: Backend Java Specialist (01-backend-java)
nodes.rationale: Owns controllers, services, clients, DTOs, and routing logic in Java 21 / Spring Boot; uses Java records for DTOs and RestClient for external LLM calls without touching SQL migrations or SecurityConfig.

nodes.label: Frontend UI Specialist (02-frontend-ui)
nodes.rationale: Owns the analytical Dashboard built with React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Recharts, and Lucide React.

nodes.label: QA Tester Specialist (03-qa-tester)
nodes.rationale: Independent quality reviewer restricted strictly to modifying test files (airouter/src/test/ and frontend/src/**/*.test.ts(x)) and forbidden from touching production code.

nodes.label: Security & DevSecOps Specialist (04-auditor-seguridad)
nodes.rationale: Owns SecurityConfig.java, RateLimitingFilter, CORS, secret protection, and multi-tenant ownership verification to prevent billing abuse and credential leakage.

nodes.label: Data Architect Specialist (05-arquitecto-datos)
nodes.rationale: Owns immutable Flyway SQL migrations, B-Tree indexing for high-volume request_logs, and JPA entity mapping rules compatible with both H2 and PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Manual Functional Testing Checklist (12 Scenarios)
nodes.rationale: Step-by-step interactive verification checklist covering Flash/Pro routing, Zero-Cost Semantic Cache, EUR/USD currency toggle, FinOps Budget Firewall, BYOK Gemini, Rate Limiting, CSV export, SHA-256 API Keys, Prepaid Wallet, and DLP PII Redaction.

nodes.label: User Manual — AI Cost Router Dashboard & FinOps Guide
nodes.norm_label: user manual — ai cost router dashboard & finops guide
nodes.rationale: End-user functional guide explaining the 5 optimization/protection engines, startup instructions, KPI cards, FinOps governance panels (Budget, API Keys, Wallet), PromptPlayground, and HTTP 400/401/402/429 alerts.

nodes.label: Programmer's Manual & Technical Architecture Specification
nodes.rationale: Exhaustive technical documentation detailing system architecture, Flyway migrations, RouterService 6-step execution flow, BigDecimal cost accounting, security hardening, React 19 frontend design, and CI/CD + Docker Compose setup.

nodes.label: GEMINI.md Global Context & Architecture Rules
nodes.rationale: Establishes global technological stack (Java 21, Spring Boot 4.1.1, React 19, Tailwind v4, Flyway), mandatory Spanish Javadoc, and ADRs.

nodes.label: PLAN_DE_ACCION.md Project Roadmap & Changelog
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for prioritized backlog items (Multi-LLM, Prompt Compressor, Circuit Breaker, FinOps ROI Simulator) and chronological history of completed milestones.

nodes.label: AI Cost Router Overview & API Reference
nodes.norm_label: ai cost router overview & api reference
nodes.rationale: Main repository documentation describing the stack, repository structure, Flyway migrations V1-V6, REST endpoints under /api/v1/router, security filters, and Docker Compose deployment.

nodes.label: Strict Dependency Execution Order (05 -> 01 -> 04 -> 02 -> 03)
nodes.rationale: Database schema must exist before Backend entities/endpoints, Security must protect new endpoints before Frontend consumes them, and QA must always run last as an independent gate.

nodes.label: Flyway Schema Governance & Hibernate Validate Mode
nodes.norm_label: flyway schema governance & hibernate validate mode
nodes.rationale: Uses spring-boot-starter-flyway with spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate so the application fails fast at startup if Java JPA entities diverge from versioned Flyway SQL migrations.

nodes.label: JPA Entity Lombok Prohibition & Manual ID Equality
nodes.norm_label: jpa entity lombok prohibition & manual id equality
nodes.rationale: @Data, @ToString, and @EqualsAndHashCode are forbidden on JPA @Entity classes to prevent infinite loops on lazy relationships and Hibernate proxy issues; equals/hashCode must be implemented manually by ID.
